description.value:
The classical shield used in Castrum Kremnos is rare and often granted as a symbol of honor to the strong. When raised, it can protect most of the body, but blocking alone is not the way of a true warrior.

"Either raise it high in triumph or return home on it."
— A saying mothers teach their children in Castrum Kremnos

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. Temporary hit points gained increase by proficiency bonus, and the creature has +1 AC while it has temporary hit points. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, increases all allies' DEF by 15% and Shield Effect received by 18% in the next battle.
